rules.description: AUTO-GATE: Block builds with i18n defects (seen 2 times)

lessons.rootCause: extractI18nKeys() only generates en values; generateFullPage() hardcoded empty objects
lessons.fix: Added buildPageI18n() that reads .i18n.json sidecar and inlines all translations
lessons.preventionRule: After page-gen, verify PAGE_I18N contains non-empty en/zh/th objects

lessons.text: Regenerating page overwrote sidecar .i18n.json with en-only data
lessons.rootCause: extractI18nKeys() only produces en; write step replaced full file
lessons.fix: Added merge logic to preserve existing zh/th translations in sidecar
lessons.preventionRule: Never overwrite .i18n.json — always merge with existing translations

lessons.text: Validation checked sidecar keys but not HTML PAGE_I18N inline content
lessons.rootCause: i18n-inject.cjs --check only reads .i18n.json, not the HTML script block
lessons.fix: Scorecard now also checks for PAGE_I18N registration in HTML
lessons.preventionRule: Validation must check both sidecar AND inline PAGE_I18N

lessons.text: REWATCH button (fixed, top-right, z-index 9990) overlapped sticky nav DLC tabs
lessons.rootCause: Both elements compete for top-right screen area; REWATCH z-index >> nav z-index
lessons.fix: Moved REWATCH to top-left below sticky nav (top: 50px, left: 12px, z-index: 99)
lessons.preventionRule: Fixed-position UI elements must not overlap sticky nav (top: 0) or FAB buttons (bottom-right)

lessons.text: Users mistook standalone DLC fragment page for the final product (only shows DLC content, no nav)
lessons.preventionRule: Fragment pages should include a banner linking to the full parent page
